sources.note: Nothing. Ch.5 Phonetics (pp.49-102) and Ch.6 Phonology (pp.103-155) cover handshape, orientation, location, movement and non-manuals of a signed language; no sign-level stress/prominence is described. Sec.10.7 'Prosodic observations' (pp.301-305) states 'this description does not include a complete analysis of LSSiv's prosody' and notes only phrase-final sign lengthening, shortening of repeated signs, and eye-gaze patterns (10.7.3, p.305); non-manuals are compared to tone/intonation at lexical and phrasal levels (5.1.5, p.80).
